trace.cypher:
MATCH (current:Player)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL
WITH t, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS lowest_medals
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, lowest_medals AS col2
